newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt airport summer cargo capacity down 4.6pc.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt airport summer cargo capacity down 4.6pc.

text.p: Air cargo capacity on freight flights out of Frankfurt airport under the summer schedule starting March 30 will total 8,852 tonnes a week, airport authority Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
This is 4.6 percent less than the 1996-97 winter timetable when 9,281 tonnes of weekly freighter capacity was available on the market.
17 airlines will operate 217 weekly freighter flights to 61 destinations in 40 countries this summer, FAG said.
The number of passenger flights has risen 3.5 percent year-on-year to 3,645 weekly frequencies while total weekly seat capacity has increased 4.4 percent to 563,992 seats, it added.
New passenger destinations include Perm and Kazan in Russia, Dalaman in Turkey, Sharm El Sheik in Egypt and Salvador in Brazil.
